name: Default
shortDescription: AutoGPT Platform for building, running and delegating work to AI agents, packaged as one container with its database, queue and memory services.

alerts.message: Signup is open to anyone who can reach the domain. Set AUTH_SIGNUP_ALLOWLIST to your email before deploying, register, run `autogpt-admin promote <email>` in the container terminal, sign out and back in, then set AUTH_ALLOW_NEW_ACCOUNTS to false and redeploy.

AutoPilot and memory need model provider keys: OPEN_ROUTER_API_KEY for chat and memory extraction, OPENAI_API_KEY for embeddings. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY with CHAT_USE_OPENROUTER set to false routes chat to Anthropic directly, but memory still needs both other keys.
The first boot applies database migrations and can take several minutes; do not stop it until it reports healthy. The stack uses about 5-6 GB of RAM.
